intro: Team Plasma will set your Pokemon free!
Hand over your Pokemon, in the name of Team Plasma!
player_won: Your bond with your Pokemon... it's real?
Team Plasma will remember this!
player_lost: Now your Pokemon can be free!

unova_juniper_intro: Professor Juniper: Oh! You're here at last.
Welcome to the world of Pokémon! I'm Professor Juniper.
I study Pokémon — creatures that live alongside people.
Your friend {rival_name} and {friend_name} have been eager to start.
Inside this case are three Pokémon. Choose one. Your adventure begins now.
unova_juniper_starter: Take good care of your new partner.
Here is your Pokédex — it records every Pokémon you encounter.
And take these Poké Balls to catch wild Pokémon.
You received a Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls!
unova_juniper_congrats: Professor Juniper: You're the Unova Champion!
I knew from the moment you picked up that first Pokémon.
You've seen more of Unova — and more of yourself — than anyone.
Here is an upgraded Pokédex with the National mode enabled.
unova_cheren_first_battle: {rival_name}: Hey, {player_name}! I opened the Professor's case early.
I've already picked my Pokémon. Now let's see what you've got!
The strongest trainer becomes Champion — that's the goal. Don't forget it.
unova_cheren_rival_won: {rival_name}: Tch. You got stronger since last time.
That's fine. It just means I need to work harder.
I'll catch up. Count on it.
unova_cheren_rival_lost: {rival_name}: Yes! That's the result of my training!
Keep up — I won't wait for you.
unova_cheren_victory_road: This is the last time I'll battle you before the League.
Show me everything. Because I'm going to show you everything I've become.
unova_bianca_first_meet: {friend_name}: Oh! {player_name}! I'm so glad you came!
Professor Juniper let me pick first — I hope that's okay!
I'm a little nervous, but... let's do our best together, okay?
unova_bianca_won: I got a little flustered when your Pokémon used that move!
But that's okay! I learned from it. That's what battles are for!
unova_bianca_nimbasa: {friend_name}: Oh — {player_name}! Fancy meeting you in the big city!
I've been battling everyone I can find. I'm getting better, I know it!
Even if I lose, the journey means something. Right? Right!
Let's battle! I want to see how far I've come!
unova_bianca_surf: {friend_name}: Ah, {player_name}! Professor Juniper said to find you.
She wanted me to give you this — the HM Surf!
Your Pokémon can now cross water. Be careful out there!
unova_n_accumula_speech: N: Pokémon and people are... different. Is it right to keep them captive?
I can hear their voices. Pokémon speak to me.
They say they are tired of being used as tools for human ambition.
My dream is a world where Pokémon and people live separately — truly free.
I wonder... what do YOUR Pokémon think of you?
unova_n_route2_battle: N: You surprised me at Accumula Town.
You spoke up. That tells me your Pokémon trust you.
I want to understand why. So let me hear your Pokémon's voice through battle.
unova_n_route2_won: N: I see. Your Pokémon's power comes from something I don't yet understand.
We will meet again, {player_name}. I'm certain of it.
unova_n_route2_lost: But perhaps your bond with your Pokémon still has room to grow.
We'll meet again. My journey continues too.
unova_n_nimbasa_ferris_wheel: N: From up here, the whole city looks so small.
People and Pokémon living together... it looks peaceful.
But is it peace, or just... habit?
I've chosen my path. I will become the hero who frees Pokémon.
And you... I think you might be the hero who opposes me.
One day we'll settle this. Until then, grow stronger.
unova_n_chargestone: N: This cave hums with energy. Pokémon born of thunder and steel.
I caught the Pokémon here before entering. Just for this battle.
You see — I release them afterward. I never keep them.
That is the difference between us.
unova_n_castle_intro: I knew you would. We were always destined to battle here.
I've called forth Zekrom — the hero of ideals.
If your truth is stronger than my ideals, prove it.
Show me the bond between you and your Pokémon!
unova_n_castle_won: N: You won. Your truth... it shone through.
I thought I knew what was right for Pokémon.
But standing here, looking at your team... maybe I was missing something.
I need to think about this. Really think.
Thank you, {player_name}. This battle... changed me.
unova_n_castle_lost: N: ...This is what I believed was right.
Pokémon and people should not be bound together.
Until you can show me otherwise — my ideal stands.
unova_ghetsis_accumula: Ghetsis: People of Unova! Hear me!
We, Team Plasma, speak for all Pokémon!
These creatures suffer under your ownership. They are enslaved!
Do the right thing. Release your Pokémon. Set them free.
Only then can a truly just world be born.
unova_ghetsis_castle_intro: Ghetsis: Hahaha. So you defeated N.
Did you think that meant anything?
N was never my goal. He was my tool. My perfect tool.
A boy who could hear Pokémon — raised to believe in liberation.
He gathered the Legendary Pokémon for me.
Now I will use that power to rule this world. With NO ONE to oppose me.
Defeat me? A child like you? Impossible. ABSOLUTELY IMPOSSIBLE!
unova_ghetsis_castle_won: How could I lose? I planned everything! EVERYTHING!
No... no, this can't be right...
Looker: Stand down, Ghetsis. It's over.
unova_plasma_grunt: Team Plasma Grunt: Pokémon liberation is justice!
We fight for the freedom of every Pokémon from human oppression!
Lord Ghetsis will create a world where only Team Plasma wields Pokémon!
unova_plasma_grunt_lost: Team Plasma Grunt: How dare you...
Team Plasma will not be stopped by a single trainer!
unova_alder_route2: Alder: Well, well. A young trainer on a journey?
I'm Alder — the Pokémon League Champion. Though I haven't been challenging lately.
My Pokémon... they remind me that every battle is precious.
If you make it to the League, come find me. I'll be waiting.
unova_alder_champion_intro: Alder: So you made it through all four of them.
I've been watching from up here. You're something special.
I've battled many trainers across Unova — none quite like you.
Come. Show me what you and your Pokémon are made of.
unova_alder_won: You know, I lost my first Pokémon partner long ago.
For a time, I forgot why I battled.
But watching you just now... I remembered.
It's the bond. It's always been the bond.
You are the new Unova Champion — congratulations!
unova_looker_intro: Looker: I am Looker, International Police.
Team Plasma has been active across Unova — stealing Pokémon, spreading propaganda.
I am investigating their leader, Ghetsis.
If you encounter any suspicious activity... find me.
unova_looker_plasma_tip: Looker: Team Plasma's king — they call him N — is not the real threat.
Ghetsis is manipulating N from the shadows.
The boy believes in Pokémon liberation. Ghetsis believes in domination.
Whatever you do — do not let Ghetsis get his hands on a Legendary Pokémon.
unova_reshiram_encounter: The legendary Dragon of Truth awakens at the top of Dragonspiral Tower!
Its white fire burns with absolute conviction.
Reshiram — the Vast White Pokémon — has appeared!
unova_zekrom_encounter: Thunder shakes Dragonspiral Tower as the legendary Dragon of Ideals stirs!
Deep Black electricity crackles through the ancient stones.
Zekrom — the Deep Black Pokémon — has appeared!
unova_kyurem_encounter: A bone-chilling cold radiates from the Giant Chasm...
The boundary Pokémon — the one that waits at the edge of the world.
unova_cobalion_encounter: A steel-bodied Pokémon watches you from the rocky plateau.
Its gaze is sharp — judging whether you are worthy.
Cobalion, the Iron Will Pokémon, challenges you!
unova_terrakion_encounter: The ground shakes beneath enormous hooves.
Terrakion, the Cavern Pokémon — a warrior who shattered castle walls to protect Pokémon.
unova_virizion_encounter: A graceful figure steps forward from the verdant forest...
Virizion, the Grassland Pokémon — its blades are sharp as any sword.
unova_tornadus_encounter: Tornadus — the Cyclone Pokémon — descends in a torrent of wind!
unova_thundurus_encounter: Lightning splits the sky with no warning!
Thundurus — the Bolt Strike Pokémon — tears across the clouds!
unova_landorus_encounter: The earth pulses with abundant energy...
Landorus — the Abundance Pokémon — descends to judge the land's balance.
unova_victini_encounter: A warm, mysterious light fills Liberty Garden...
A small Pokémon with enormous lucky power bounces toward you!
unova_volcarona_encounter: Ancient ruins in Relic Castle deep below the sands...
A Pokémon born from ancient fire, said to have replaced the sun when it was covered in ash.
unova_museum_plasma: A Team Plasma Grunt burst from the museum holding the Dragon Skull!
Lenora: They stole the Dragonite Skull! After them — please!
Team Plasma cannot be allowed to reconstruct the ancient Dragon!
unova_plasma_nacrene_won: The Dragon Skull has been recovered!
Lenora: Thank you. This belongs to Nacrene Museum — and to history.
That Pokémon Skull holds the secret of Unova's Dragon legend.
unova_castelia_sewers: Burgh: Team Plasma is hiding in the sewers beneath Castelia City.
They're using it as a base — I won't let them defile my city.
I'll handle this side. You take the other. Let's push them out!
unova_n_throne: N: This castle rose overnight. Every stone placed by Pokémon who believe in my dream.
They trust me. And I trust them.
The age of liberation begins here, {player_name}.
Become the new hero — or fall before the hero of ideals.
b2_newgame_intro: Aspertia City sits on Unova's south-west corner, under the mountains.
Today Mom has some news for you. Go and see her before you head out!
unova_newgame_intro: A package arrives in Nuvema Town, addressed to you and your friends.
Inside: a note from Professor Juniper and three Poké Balls.
'Choose one partner each. Your journey through Unova starts today!'
unova_mom_newstart_1: Mom: Professor Juniper's gift arrived! I'm so proud of you, {player_name}.
Mom: Go see the whole Unova region. Just call me once in a while!
unova_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Castelia City has the tallest buildings you've ever seen.
Mom: If you win enough prize money, buy me one of those famous Casteliacones!
unova_mom_newstart_3: Mom: Your father traveled Unova when he was young, too.
Mom: He always said the best adventures start with a single step out the door.
unova_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! Our Aspertia house looks out over the whole city!
Mom: Your Sinnoh championship paid for every brick. I made sure of it.
Mom: Five regions, five homes. My scrapbook is getting heavy!
unova_mom_home_2: Mom: I visited the Castelia Gym yesterday. Burgh painted my portrait!
Mom: I told him my child is a champion. He painted a crown on me, too.
unova_mom_home_3: Mom: The neighbors asked how a family can own houses in five regions.
Mom: I told them: 'Math homework.' They didn't believe me.
unova_cheren_house: {rival_name}'s Mom: {rival_name} is studying the Trainer handbook again.
{rival_name}'s Mom: He says he'll be the strongest trainer in Unova. I believe him!

requirements.fail_text: Marlon's out swimming... and he only battles Trainers with seven Badges.

player_won: Marlon: You don't just look strong, you're strong fo' reals! Eh, I was swept away, too!
{player_name} received the Wave Badge from Marlon!

Marlon: Shoots! I'm off then!
player_lost: Marlon: Waves can be rough or calm, but it's still the same sea!

player_won: Okay, you're good! But can you beat Cheren?

intro: I'll show you everything I learned from Cheren!
player_won: I have to learn even more about my Pokemon!

intro: Cheren: This is your first Gym challenge, and my first battle as a Gym Leader!
Cheren: Let's both do our best, and have a battle we can be proud of!
player_won: Cheren: I'm really glad you were my first challenger. Here's the Basic Badge!
Cheren: And TM230 Work Up: it raises Attack and Sp. Atk. A TM can be used again and again.
Cheren: There are eight Gyms in Unova. Collect them all, and fill that Pokedex as you go!
player_lost: Cheren: A good battle. Train with your Pokemon, and come back any time.

requirements.fail_text: Roxie can't hear you over the band! Beat her two bandmates to stop the music first.

intro: Can't hear ya over the music! Let's battle instead!
player_won: The music stopped... that means I lost!

intro: This next song is a poisonous one!
player_won: My strings! You've cut the show short!

intro: Roxie: Get ready! I'm gonna knock some sense outta ya!
Roxie: Poison days, poison on the stage! Let's rock!
player_won: Roxie: Sigh! What are you doing losing, Roxie?! Well... I guess that means you're strong!
Roxie: I gave it everything, and I feel refreshed! Here: the Toxic Badge!
Roxie: Two Badges! Pokemon up to Lv. 40 will listen to you now, even traded ones.
Roxie: And TM045 Venoshock! It does double damage if the target's already poisoned. Almost too much punch!
player_lost: Roxie: Your Pokemon wanted it, but mine wanted it more! Come back and rock again!

intro: Hey {player_name}! I opened Juniper's case! My Pokémon is ready — are you?
player_won: Tch. You already beat me. Fine. I'll catch up.
player_lost: Ha! I'm the stronger trainer already. Now let's go see the Professor.

intro: Bianca: Welcome home, Champion! I've been training the whole time. Battle me!
player_won: Bianca: Hehe, you're still the best!
player_lost: Better luck next time!

intro: Gym Leader: Welcome to Striaton Gym!
One of us will face you — the one whose type counters your starter!
We are Cilan, Chili, and Cress — and together we serve the finest battles in Unova!
player_won: Gym Leader: Magnificent! You've earned the Trio Badge!
With it, Pokémon up to a certain level will obey you.
Take this TM as well — a gift from the three of us!
player_lost: Gym Leader: The type advantage was decisive today.
Come back once you've trained more. We'll be here.

requirements.fail_text: This Gym was one of Unova's two years ago. Become Unova's Champion, then come back: the Striaton trio will battle you as they did then.

intro: Cheren: Before the Gym, let's see how our Pokémon have grown.
player_won: Cheren: I see. I need to think this through.
player_lost: Better luck next time!

intro: Lenora: Welcome to my gym — and my library!
I'm Lenora, the Nacrene Gym Leader.
I'm a Normal-type user. Don't underestimate what Normal can do!
player_won: Lenora: You're the real deal! Congratulations on the Basic Badge!
Take this HM Strength too — you'll need it in your travels.
Take this Cover Fossil too. The fossil lab in Nacrene City can revive it!
player_lost: Lenora: You'll need to dig deeper than that!
Come back when you've trained more. My library is always open.

requirements.fail_text: This Gym was one of Unova's two years ago. Become Unova's Champion, then come back: Lenora will battle you as they did then.

intro: We have the Dragon Skull! Team Plasma's plan is unstoppable!
player_won: The skull... we've lost it. Lord Ghetsis will be furious!
player_lost: Team Plasma serves a higher justice than your victories!

intro: N: Your Pokémon... I want to hear them speak. Battle me.
player_won: N: They said they like you. How strange.

requirements.fail_text: Burgh isn't back at his Gym yet.

intro: Welcome to the cocoons! Hope you don't get tangled up!
player_won: All wrapped up... in defeat!

intro: Ta-da! Bugs and clowns, the best show in town!
player_won: The show's over? Already?

intro: Which way did you come in? The cocoons care, you know!
player_won: Ooh, you found the right thread!

intro: When the cocoon breaks open, the one that pops out is... me!
player_won: Hiding makes battle instincts dull...

intro: Burgh: Good work back there in the sewers! My Bug Pokemon are scurrying to battle you.
Burgh: Dwebble's round little eyes are cute! And my ace, Leavanny, sews clothes for other Pokemon out of leaves!
Burgh: Well now... let's get right to it!
player_won: Burgh: Oh hoo... You're very strong indeed! Here, the Insect Badge. It suits you!
Burgh: With three Badges, Pokemon up to Lv. 50 will obey you, even traded ones.
Burgh: And take TM015 Struggle Bug, too. It lowers the Sp. Atk of whatever it hits. The little things count!
player_lost: Burgh: A lovely effort! Come back when your Pokemon are ready.

travel_options.message: The ferry leaves Castelia's pier for the colorful Decolore Islands.

requirements.fail_text: The show isn't at its finale yet! Beat the Trainers waiting along the catwalk first.

intro: Elesa: Welcome to the main stage! My Pokemon and yours will see whose star shines brightest.
player_won: Elesa: You're an even more wonderful Trainer than I expected. Your fighting style swept me off my feet!
{player_name} received the Bolt Badge from Elesa!
Elesa: And here's a move I like: Volt Switch. Hit, then trade places with another of your Pokemon.
player_lost: Elesa: The spotlight stays on me this time. Shine brighter and come back!

intro: Clay: Harrumph! Kept me waitin', didn't ya, kid? All right, let's see what ya can do!
player_won: Clay: Phew... You're really somethin'! Here, take this!
{player_name} received the Quake Badge from Clay!
Clay: Yer fifth Badge, huh? And take this too: Bulldoze. Hits and slows 'em down!
Clay: If ya think ya can go somewhere, go. Decide yer own limits!
player_lost: Clay: Mrmph. Dig a little deeper and come back.

intro: Bianca: My dad wanted me to go home... but I'm not giving up! Battle!
player_won: Bianca: I'm going to keep traveling. I've decided!
player_lost: Better luck next time!

intro: Skyla: Hee-hee! I've been waiting for you. You're tough enough to face the wind and not get blown off your feet!
Skyla: I'm kinda excited about this battle! Let's have some fun!
player_won: Skyla: You're an amazing Trainer. For the first time in about two years, my Pokemon and I fought with our full strength!
{player_name} received the Jet Badge from Skyla!
Skyla: Wow, hot stuff! With that many Badges, Pokemon up to Lv 80 will obey you.
Skyla: And take this TM, Acrobatics, so you'll always remember this battle!
player_lost: Skyla: The wind's at my back today! Train up and fly right back.

intro: Brycen: I am Brycen. I was once a film star — now I am a Gym Leader.
Ice-types embody discipline and stillness.
Strike with precision.
player_won: Brycen: You move with purpose. Well done. Accept the Freeze Badge.
Now go — Dragonspiral Tower needs your attention.
player_lost: Brycen: Discipline. You need more of it.
Return when your movements are as clean as ice.

requirements.fail_text: This Gym was one of Unova's two years ago. Become Unova's Champion, then come back: Brycen will battle you as they did then.

intro: N: This tower holds the hero's Dragon. My path leads here. Don't try to stop me.
player_won: N: You... you stopped me again. But Zekrom heard my call. We'll meet again.
player_lost: N: The Dragon of Ideals has chosen me. The hero of truth must still rise.

player_won: Drayden: Wonderful. Battles are about meeting our challenges together, with others.
{player_name} received the Legend Badge from Drayden!
Drayden: With seven badges, Pokemon up to Lv 90 will obey you.

player_won: Shauntal: Wonderful! This will make a brilliant chapter!
player_lost: Shauntal: The Ghost-type ending. A classic.

player_won: Marshal: You have both strength and focus. I acknowledge you!
player_lost: Marshal: Your spirit fights, but your body must follow.

intro: Grimsley: Winning and losing are two sides of the same coin.

player_won: Grimsley: Ha. You called my bluff. Well played.

player_won: Caitlin: You saw through my Pokémon too. Congratulations.
player_lost: Caitlin: I saw every move before you made it.

N's Castle is rising! The battle isn't over yet, Champion.

lines: Pokemon Ranger: I found this Egg by the cliffs, but it needs a trainer who travels.
Something warm and fiery is inside. Will you take care of it?

boss.name: Black Fog
lines: The air turns ice-cold. A black fog pours between the graves...
Two huge eyes open in the dark. A giant Haunter rises: the Black Fog!
Long ago people worshipped it as a god. It feeds on dreams. Don't let it get yours!
won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

lines: The lab is empty. A note on the desk reads:
"Genesect capsules moved to Torom Island, Decolore. Drives to follow."
The Decolore ferry leaves from Castelia City.

area_boss.name: Genesect
lines: Deep in the lab, a capsule cracks open. An ancient Pokemon, rebuilt by Team Plasma, steps out...
Genesect fires up its cannon!

boss.name: Regirock
lines: Regirock appears!

boss.name: Regice
lines: Regice appears!

boss.name: Registeel
lines: Registeel appears!

boss.name: Keldeo
lines: A small Pokémon stands proudly in the grove: Keldeo, the Colt Pokémon!
You dive deep into the sunken ruins. Strange carvings cover the walls...
Something glitters in the silt!

boss.name: Uxie
lines: Uxie appears!

boss.name: Mesprit
lines: Mesprit appears!

boss.name: Azelf
lines: Azelf appears!
Pokémon from dreams drift between the trees... then fade, smiling.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Find Bianca
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Juniper's assistant Bianca is somewhere in Aspertia City with a Pokémon for you. Look for a big green hat! {rival_name} thinks she's up at the Outlook.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Bianca's Tour
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Your first Pokemon needs a rest after its first battle. Bianca is waiting at Aspertia's Pokemon Center, and so is Mom.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Catching Lesson
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Bianca is waiting on Route 19, just through the gate at the north end of Aspertia. She'll show you how to catch a Pokémon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Alder's Town
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Alder went on ahead to Floccesy Town, east along Route 19. Catch up with him there!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Two Town Maps
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {rival_name} was seen training on Route 20, east of Floccesy. Find him and give him his Town Map. He may have gone up to Floccesy Ranch!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Missing Herdier
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: One of Floccesy Ranch's Herdier has wandered off. Search the woods at the north of the ranch with {rival_name}.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Alder's Training
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Herdier is home safe. Go back to Floccesy Town: Alder is waiting at his house to train you.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Basic Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Aspertia's Gym is open! It's behind the Trainers' School. Beat Cheren's two Gym Trainers, then Cheren himself.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: East to Virbank
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The next Gym is in Virbank City. Go through Floccesy and east along Route 20. Hiker Jerome will let you up the steps now.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Virbank's Gym
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Roxie leads Virbank City's Poison-type Gym, a rock club south of the Pokémon Center. Beat her two bandmates to stop the music, then challenge her.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pokéstar Studios
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A scout from Pokéstar Studios wants you in the movies! Go north through Virbank's gate to the studios.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble at the Docks
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Roxie and {rival_name} have Team Plasma cornered on Virbank's pier, east of the Gym. Help them out!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Runaway Grunt
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: One Grunt fled west to Route 20. Climb the steps in the middle of the route, then look south in a small clearing.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ship to Castelia
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Pop Roxie is back on Virbank's pier. Board his ship at the terminal for Castelia City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Big City
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Castelia City! Its Gym is on Gym Street, up from the waterfront. Go and see Gym Leader Burgh.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Iris's Hunch
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Burgh is away. Iris thinks Team Plasma could be hiding by Thumb Pier, east along the waterfront.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Into the Sewers
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {rival_name} ran into the Castelia Sewers from Thumb Pier. Follow him, then climb the north stairs after Team Plasma.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Burgh's Gym
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Burgh is back at the Castelia Gym on Gym Street. Find your way through the cocoons to him.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Man in the White Coat
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With Burgh's badge in hand, head for Central Plaza, the heart of Castelia, on the way to Route 4.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Colress Waits
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Colress wants to test his theory in a battle. He's waiting on Route 4, north through Castelia's gate.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The City of Lights
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Nimbasa City is north through Join Avenue. Its Gym Leader, Elesa, is a famous model. Find the Gym in the amusement park, east of the city.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Leader Is Out
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Elesa isn't at her Gym. The guide says she went to the roller coaster building by the park's entrance.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Elesa's Runway
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Elesa is back at the Nimbasa Gym, east of the Ferris wheel. Beat the Trainers on the catwalk, then Elesa.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble at Big Stadium
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {rival_name} is shouting at Team Plasma outside Big Stadium, in the west of Nimbasa. He could use some help.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: West to Route 5
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The road to Driftveil runs west through Nimbasa's gate, along Route 5 to the drawbridge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Over the Drawbridge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With the drawbridge lowered, Driftveil City waits on the far side of the river, and its Gym Leader Clay with it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Team Plasma, Old and New
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A former member of Team Plasma said their old base is on the hill north of the Gym. What are they up to?

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Down the Mine
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Clay's Gym is a dark mine. Ride the conveyor belts from platform to platform and find the Underground Boss.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The World Tournament
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Clay invited you to the Pokemon World Tournament, south of Driftveil. Trainers from all over the world compete there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Aboard the Plasma Frigate
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma Grunts ran past the World Tournament to a ship at the pier. {rival_name}'s gone after them. Follow him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Cold Snap
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cheren went ahead to Route 6. Something about the weather has him worried. Find him at the Season Research Lab.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Charged Stones
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Chargestone Cave's floating stones crackle with power. Mistralton City and its Gym lie on the far side.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Wind Tunnel
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Skyla, Mistralton's pilot and Gym Leader, runs her Gym in an aircraft hangar. Mind the turbines!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Over the Mountain
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Twist Mountain has caved in. Skyla will fly Professor Juniper over it from the Cargo Service. Fetch the professor from Celestial Tower and get aboard!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Smouldering Mountain
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Juniper wants you to ask Opelucid's Gym Leader, Drayden, about the legendary dragons. The way east is through Reversal Mountain, where Bianca is chasing rumours of a rare Pokemon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Town with Walls
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Route 13 runs north along the coast to Lacunosa, a town walled in against something that comes at night. Professor Juniper and Bianca are waiting there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: West to Opelucid
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma is after the creature from Lacunosa's old tale. Opelucid City, and Drayden, are west along Route 12 and across Village Bridge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Dragon Mayor
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Opelucid City's mayor is its Gym Leader too: Drayden, master of Dragon types. Iris says to train on Route 9 first. Ride the dragon statues to the top!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A World of Ice
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Drayden has a story about the dragons, and a family treasure Team Plasma wants. Hear him out at his house, then help him drive Team Plasma out of Opelucid.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Coldest Place
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Shadow Triad got away with the DNA Splicers. Cheren says the coldest place in Unova is near Humilau City: take the Marine Tube from Undella Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: More Splash than the Sea
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Humilau's Gym Leader is somewhere in the ocean. Find Marlon, then ride the lily pads of his Gym for the last Badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Presence on Route 22
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma could be anywhere west of Humilau. {rival_name} wants Route 22 searched.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Sturdy Boulder
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Colress saw something in Seaside Cave, south of Humilau on Route 21, that reminded him of Route 4. His machine might wake it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ship off Route 21
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Beyond the cave, the Plasma Frigate lies at anchor by the cliffs.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Into the Giant Chasm
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Plasma Frigate flew toward the Giant Chasm, where Lacunosa's monster sleeps. Cheren says the way in is from Route 22.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma is finished and Opelucid has thawed. N asked you to go to the Pokemon League: Route 23 leaves the Giant Chasm to the west, and Victory Road climbs to the League.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Pokemon League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Past Victory Road's last tunnel stands the Pokemon League. Four of the Elite Four wait, then the Champion.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Team Plasma's Speech
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Follow Route 1 north to Accumula Town. A group called Team Plasma is giving a speech in the square. Go and listen.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Stranger Named N
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: On Route 2 you'll meet Alder, and a strange young man named N who says he can hear Pokémon talk. He wants to battle!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Gift in the Dreamyard
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A researcher named Fennel is at the Dreamyard, next to Striaton City. She has a Pokémon that's strong against the Striaton Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trio Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Striaton City's Gym has three leaders: Cilan, Chili and Cress. You'll face the one whose type beats your partner's!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Basic Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Go through Route 3 and Wellspring Cave to Nacrene City. Lenora, the museum's director, leads the Normal-type Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Stolen Dragon Skull
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma is in the Nacrene Museum! They want the giant Dragon Skull. Stop them!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Chase Through Pinwheel Forest
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma ran into Pinwheel Forest with the skull. Burgh takes one path. Catch the grunts on the other!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Castelia's Sewers
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cross Skyarrow Bridge to Castelia City, Unova's biggest city. Team Plasma is hiding in the sewers. Help Burgh clear them out!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Insect Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Burgh, the artist, is ready at the Castelia Gym. His Bug-types hide in a honeycomb maze.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ferris Wheel
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head up sandy Route 4 to Nimbasa City. N is at the amusement park, and he has something to tell you.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Bolt Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Elesa, a model, leads Nimbasa's Electric-type Gym. Ride the roller coaster to reach her!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Quake Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Take Route 5 and Driftveil Drawbridge to Driftveil City. Team Plasma is hiding in the Cold Storage south of town. Then face Clay's Ground-types.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lights in Chargestone Cave
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Route 6 leads to Chargestone Cave, full of floating electric stones. N is waiting deep inside.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Jet Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Mistralton City has an airport! Skyla is a pilot, and her Flying-type Gym shoots you out of cannons.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Freeze Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Follow Route 7 through Twist Mountain to snowy Icirrus City. Brycen, a movie star, uses Ice-types.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Dragonspiral Tower
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma stormed Dragonspiral Tower, the oldest tower in Unova. N is calling a legendary dragon at the top!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Dragon Stones
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cross Tubeline Bridge and Route 9 to Opelucid City. Drayden knows about the stones that hold the legendary dragons.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Legend Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Drayden's Dragon-types are the last Gym in Unova. Ice-type moves work well against dragons!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Unova League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With eight badges, take Route 10 and climb Victory Road. Beat the Elite Four, then the Champion, Alder!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: N's Castle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: N's Castle rose out of the ground behind the League! Get past the Seven Sages and battle N.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Stop Ghetsis
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Ghetsis was using N all along! Stop him to save Unova.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Team Plasma at Relic Castle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma is digging in Relic Castle, out in the Desert Resort. Ask in Driftveil City and go stop them.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Iron Will Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cobalion, one of the Swords of Justice, waits in Mistralton Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Cavern Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Terrakion, another of the Swords of Justice, guards a hidden cave on Victory Road.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Grassland Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Virizion, the last of the Swords of Justice, hides on Route 22, west of Opelucid City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Colt Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With all three Swords of Justice met, young Keldeo appears in the Moor of Icirrus.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ancient Sun
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Deep inside Relic Castle, Volcarona sleeps. Long ago, people said it took the sun's place.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Other Dragon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: N's legendary dragon has left. Its partner still waits at Dragonspiral Tower.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Boundary Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Lacunosa Town's elder tells of a monster in the Giant Chasm. Find Kyurem in the cold.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Storm and Thunder
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Storms keep sweeping across Routes 7 and 8, and the thunder sounds almost like laughter.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Abundant Shrine
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With the storms calmed, Landorus appears at the Abundant Shrine, east of Undella Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Larvesta's Egg
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A Pokémon Ranger on Route 18 has an egg that needs a good home.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Aspertia's Gym
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cheren runs Aspertia City's Gym now, in the southwest. He's been waiting for a real challenge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Virbank's Gym
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Roxie plays in a band and leads Virbank City's Poison-type Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Humilau's Gym
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Marlon, a laid-back surfer, leads the Water-type Gym in Humilau City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Champion Iris
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Iris sits in the Champion's chair at the Pokemon League now.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Plasma Frigate
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A ship with no flag lies off Humilau City, and a new Team Plasma crews it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pokémon World Tournament
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Leaders and Champions from every region are gathering near Driftveil City for a tournament.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Golems of Clay Tunnel
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Regirock, Regice and Registeel sleep in the Underground Ruins past Clay Tunnel.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Colossal Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With all three Regis in your party, something deep in Twist Mountain begins to stir.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Reversal Mountain
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Heatran lives in the lava deep inside Reversal Mountain, near Lentimas Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Black Tower and White Treehollow
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Black Tower in Black City and White Treehollow in the White Forest go deeper every time. How far can you get?

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Swap on Route 4
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Someone in a house on Route 4 has a Pokemon to swap. Bring them the one they're hoping for.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Avenue Needs a Manager
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: North of Route 4, a whole street of empty shops is waiting for someone to bring it to life.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Royal Unova
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Each evening a cruise ship leaves Castelia's Cruise Dock, full of Trainers. Beat every one aboard before it docks.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Lighthouse on the Island
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Out past Liberty Pier, something small has been seen near the old lighthouse. It seems to bring good luck.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Two on Two
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Outside Gear Station, a Trainer wants a partner to take on the Subway Bosses, Ingo and Emmet. They'll only battle two on two.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Lost Pansage
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A girl on Anville Town's platform lost her Pansage: it got on the wrong train home from Nimbasa. Someone at a Nimbasa station might have seen it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Last Stop: the Subway Boss
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Seven Trainers to a train, three trains in a row on the Single Train, and the Subway Boss Ingo waits for whoever gets that far.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Summer at Undella
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Hugh is waiting in Undella Town, down the coast past Route 14. He wants one more battle, and he has something for you.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Villa by the Sea
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A famous Trainer is staying at the villa in Undella Town. Knock and see who answers.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Reveal Glass
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: An old man at the Abundant Shrine has a mirror that shows a Pokemon's true form. Bring Landorus along and he'll show you.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Lunar Wing
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The girl in the Strange House asked for her wing to go home. Take the Lunar Wing to Marvelous Bridge and walk under its eastern arch.
